title: Your playbook
lead: Instructions for the parts of your week AI already helps with. Copy one into ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, then check what comes back against the list under it.
grows: Your playbook grows as you practise. Start with the starter instructions below.

card.slots: Fill in the parts in brackets before you send it.
card.copiedToast: Copied. Paste it into ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot.
card.copyFailed: Your browser didn't let us copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
card.below: Your best practice instruction here scored {score} of 100. Score {bar} or more and it takes this place.
card.writing: Writing the starter instruction for this task
card.unavailable: The starter instruction didn't load. Try again in a minute.
card.missing: There's no starter for this task. Practise it once and your own instruction will appear here.

edit.label: Your version of the instruction
edit.hint: Keep the parts in brackets for what you paste each time.
edit.saved: Saved. This is the version you'll copy from now on.

checks.title: What I check before I use the result
checks.slip: You missed this in Spot the slip
checks.pending: The checklist appears with the starter instruction.
checks.none: No checks for this task yet. Practise it once and what slipped past you will land here.

locked.title: {task} comes with Max
locked.reason: Max opens a checked instruction and checklist for every task AI helps with in your week, and keeps your own best versions.

empty.noMapBody: Your playbook is built from the tasks in your week map. It takes about two minutes.
empty.noTasksTitle: Nothing to hand to AI yet
empty.noTasksBody: None of the tasks in your week are ones AI already helps with, so there's nothing to put here yet. Your week map shows where your human edge is.

toSecondLook.title: Got an AI draft at work?
toSecondLook.body: Paste it into Second look and see where a careful {job} would check it before it goes out.

errors.too_long: That's longer than we can keep. Shorten it a little.
errors.text_too_short: Paste at least a few sentences.
errors.text_too_long: That's over 4,000 characters. Paste the part you want checked.
errors.no_xray: Make your week map first: your playbook is built from its tasks.
errors.not_found: This task is no longer in your week. Reload the page.

secondLook.title: Second look
secondLook.lead: Paste something an AI wrote for your work. We'll point to the places a careful {job} would check before using it.
secondLook.leadNoJob: Paste something an AI wrote for your work. We'll point to the places a careful specialist would check before using it.
secondLook.field: Paste something an AI wrote for your work
secondLook.placeholder: A letter to a patient, an email to a client, an estimate, a report summary
secondLook.privacy: Remove names and personal details first.
secondLook.kept: We read it once and don't keep it. Only the number of checks is saved.
secondLook.noMapTasks: Map your week to pick one of your tasks here.
secondLook.reading: Reading it the way a {job} would
secondLook.readingNoJob: Reading it the way a specialist would
secondLook.failed: We couldn't read this one. Your text is still in the box.
secondLook.freeOne: Your first second look is free.
secondLook.lookFor: It looks for numbers and doses that don't add up, facts that may be wrong, rules, missing parts, tone and reasoning.

result.cleanBody: Read it once more for names and numbers.
result.honest: These are places to double-check, not a verdict. You know your work.

locked.title: Your free second look is used
locked.reason: Max gives you a second look at every AI draft from your work, along with the full playbook and your personal coach.

secondLook.toPlaybook: Your playbook has ready instructions for the tasks AI helps with.
